__comment: Craft recipes by section: Rudimentary (Workers) unless a recipe names its `section`, which the career with that craft_section makes (professions.json, doc 292). `catch_log` names the Ranger's log count a batch adds to. A recipe with `batch_hours` leaves its batch on the workshop that long (the drying rack's fish, doc 292; copper melting in the basic smelter, doc 297): the workshop holds it, then its career takes it down in `collect_seconds` (Task COLLECT); `batch_words` word it (`working`, `done`; the fish's Drying and Dry without them), and `collect_sound` names the sound it is taken down with (a kind in data/audio/work_feedback.json: the copper bar's smelt_bar; none when absent). CraftingManager is the single data owner. ingredient_count matching timber units per batch, plus one unit per additional_ingredients entry, physically collected before work. output_count is finished units. Finite quantities are batches; maintain quantities are spare units. The first bench needs no workshop. Tools can be crafted and stored: Workers make the Ranger's kit and the stone hammer, Blacksmiths the copper tools of the other trades (doc 306). A career's own workbench is made by that career at the crude workbench from raw goods (doc 293). ingredient_tag names the material tag of the batch's goods (timber, fish, or stockpile_stone for the rough stone alone), and ingredient_words how the window and waiting reasons word them (timber's when absent). `one_of` names goods a batch takes one choice of (doc 306): `choices` lists them best first, each a list of exact item keys, and the first the colony can supply is taken, after the fixed ingredients and before the batch's own goods; `label` heads them on the recipe's card (Fuel, Haft) and `words` word a wait ("Waiting for a coal or two logs"). A wooden choice gives a `material_group` recipe its wood when the batch's own goods have none (a copper tool's haft). Planks (doc 308): each wood has a sawing recipe of its own, one log into two planks, whose ingredient_tag is that log's own tag, so the output is always that wood's plank; plank furniture takes ingredient_tag plank, planks of one wood.

recipes.name: Crude workbench
recipes.description: A rough stump with an axe-hewn top for the colony's first crafts. Workers can make it on clear ground, then haul and install it through Place.
recipes.flavour: Every hall began as a stump and a dwarf with an axe.

recipes.name: Log torch
recipes.description: A charred branch bound with rough fibre and held by a wooden wall peg. A basic light for the first tunnels.
recipes.flavour: Dark corners breed rumours. Light them.

recipes.name: Ladder section
recipes.description: Split raw timber into pegged rails and rungs. Each section installs four blocks; taller routes need several sections.
recipes.flavour: Down is easy. Up is where the rungs earn their keep.

recipes.name: Campfire
recipes.description: A low outdoor stone-ring fire, centered in a 3 × 3 camp area. Place stools around its edges to gather by the light.
recipes.flavour: Stones in a ring, logs in the middle, stories all around.
recipes.purpose: Outdoor gathering and light. A worker lights it at dusk with a log; it burns until dawn.

recipes.name: Log stool
recipes.description: A short log cut flat for sitting, with rough bark sides. A simple stump seat for the first camp.
recipes.flavour: Sit low, eat well, argue loudly.
recipes.purpose: Idle dwarves can sit here and return to work when needed.

recipes.name: Log bed
recipes.description: Fit rough logs into a low frame and heap it with hay and dried leaves. A simple place for one dwarf to sleep. Workers make it at the crude workbench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: Straw on logs beats stone on stone.
recipes.purpose: Dwarves prefer a free bed over the ground. A bed, door, light and sealed enclosure make a bedroom.

recipes.name: Log door (2 wide)
recipes.description: One rough log leaf swings open as dwarves approach. Fits a 2-block-wide opening and seals the room for warmth. Workers make it at the crude workbench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: A door is a wall that learned manners.

recipes.name: Log door (3 wide)
recipes.description: One rough log leaf swings open as dwarves approach. Fits a 3-block-wide opening and seals the room for warmth. Workers make it at the crude workbench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: Wide enough for a barrel, snug enough to stop the draught.

recipes.name: Double log door (4 wide)
recipes.description: Two rough log leaves swing open as dwarves approach. Fits a 4-block-wide opening and seals the room for warmth. Workers make it at the crude workbench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: Big doors for big halls, and bigger quarrels over who left them open.

recipes.name: Ranger's kit
recipes.description: A stone-tipped spear and a peeled fishing rod, bound with rope. Needs no metal or bowstring.
recipes.flavour: A rod for the river, a spear for the woods.
recipes.purpose: The Ranger's starter tool: a dwarf promoted to Ranger collects one. They fish with its rod; the spear waits for hunting.

recipes.name: Stone hammer
recipes.description: A heavy stone head fitted to a wooden handle for the colony's first metalworking tools.
recipes.flavour: The first hammer is always the heaviest.
recipes.purpose: The Blacksmith's starter tool. A Worker collects it when promoted to Blacksmith.

recipes.name: Drying rack
recipes.description: Two forked posts and a crossbar lashed with rope: the Ranger's own workbench. Fish hung along it dry into food that keeps a season. Rangers make it at the crude workbench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: A winter's dinner, hung out in the autumn wind.
recipes.purpose: Rangers dry fresh fish on it, two of a kind at a time, into dried fish that keeps about thirty days.

recipes.name: Carpenter's bench
recipes.description: A thick slab hewn flat on top, one end let into a bark stump, the chopping block, the other on two peeled legs: the Carpenter's own workbench. Carpenters make it at the crude workbench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: A bench is a carpenter's first piece and last argument.
recipes.purpose: The Carpenter's own workbench. Carpenters make their goods at it.

recipes.name: Pine planks
recipes.description: A pine log sawn along its length into two thick boards with the copper saw. Carpenters saw planks at the carpenter's bench.
recipes.flavour: A log is a tree lying down. A plank is a tree put to work.
recipes.purpose: The Carpenter's plank furniture is made from planks of one wood. Planks are stored as Planks, on the ground or on a finished goods pallet.
recipes.purpose_short: Two planks from a log, for the Carpenter's furniture.

recipes.name: Oak planks
recipes.description: An oak log sawn along its length into two thick boards with the copper saw. Carpenters saw planks at the carpenter's bench.
recipes.flavour: A log is a tree lying down. A plank is a tree put to work.
recipes.purpose: The Carpenter's plank furniture is made from planks of one wood. Planks are stored as Planks, on the ground or on a finished goods pallet.
recipes.purpose_short: Two planks from a log, for the Carpenter's furniture.

recipes.name: Juniper planks
recipes.description: A juniper log sawn along its length into two thick boards with the copper saw. Carpenters saw planks at the carpenter's bench.
recipes.flavour: A log is a tree lying down. A plank is a tree put to work.
recipes.purpose: The Carpenter's plank furniture is made from planks of one wood. Planks are stored as Planks, on the ground or on a finished goods pallet.
recipes.purpose_short: Two planks from a log, for the Carpenter's furniture.

recipes.name: Applewood planks
recipes.description: An applewood log sawn along its length into two thick boards with the copper saw. Carpenters saw planks at the carpenter's bench.
recipes.flavour: A log is a tree lying down. A plank is a tree put to work.
recipes.purpose: The Carpenter's plank furniture is made from planks of one wood. Planks are stored as Planks, on the ground or on a finished goods pallet.
recipes.purpose_short: Two planks from a log, for the Carpenter's furniture.

recipes.name: Tool rack
recipes.description: A broad sawn board pegged to a wall, with three stout pegs to hang tools on. Made from two matching planks. Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench; it is then installed against a wall through Place.
recipes.flavour: A tool on a peg is a tool you can find.
recipes.purpose: Holds three of the colony's tools, one to a hook. It is filled before ground storage.
recipes.purpose_short: Holds three tools on a wall.

ingredient_words.same: All planks must be the same wood.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a wood to allow it.

recipes.name: Raw materials crate
recipes.description: A plank bin, open on top: a sawn post at each corner and two boards a side, pegged. Made from four matching planks. Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench; it is then installed on the floor through Place.
recipes.flavour: What the mine gives, the crib keeps.
recipes.purpose: Holds twelve raw goods, three to each quarter: rough stone, ores and coal, and soil. It is filled before ground storage.
recipes.purpose_short: Holds twelve stones, ores or soil.

ingredient_words.same: All planks must be the same wood.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a wood to allow it.

recipes.name: Finished goods pallet
recipes.description: Four sawn deck boards pegged across three runners, with gaps between them. Made from four matching planks. Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench; it is then installed on the floor through Place.
recipes.flavour: Made is not placed. Until then, it waits on the poles.
recipes.purpose: Holds the colony's finished goods: one piece of packed furniture or three metal goods, such as copper bars, to each of its four quarters. It is filled before ground storage.

ingredient_words.same: All planks must be the same wood.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a wood to allow it.

recipes.name: Food shelf
recipes.description: Two plank shelves pegged between two plank ends, the upper one shallower. Made from four matching planks. Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench; it is then installed on the floor through Place.
recipes.flavour: Off the floor, out of the muck.
recipes.purpose: Holds six crates of food, three to a deck. It is filled before ground storage, and food keeps there as it would on the floor beside it.

ingredient_words.same: All planks must be the same wood.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a wood to allow it.

recipes.name: Plank dining table
recipes.description: Four broad boards pegged across two plank ends, tied under each long side. Made from four matching planks. Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: A table turns a meal into a feast, and a feast into a story.
recipes.purpose: Add separate stools at the four guides for seated dining.

ingredient_words.same: All planks must be the same wood.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a wood to allow it.

recipes.name: Plank bench
recipes.description: Two boards pegged onto two plank ends, with a stretcher between them. Made from two matching planks. Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: Room for three dwarves, or two after supper.

ingredient_words.same: All planks must be the same wood.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a wood to allow it.

recipes.name: Log fence post
recipes.description: Stands in the middle of a tile. Two level rails join posts on neighboring tiles, forming straight runs, corners and junctions. Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: A row of posts tells beasts and neighbours where the colony begins.

recipes.name: Log gate
recipes.description: Hangs across one tile between posts on the tiles either side, sharing posts with connected fences. Opens as dwarves approach and does not seal a room. Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: A fence that knows when to open.

recipes.name: Board-game table
recipes.description: A game scratched across the top of a plank table, with loose stones for counters. Made from four matching planks and a rough stone. Add one stool for solo play, or two opposite stools to play together for more happiness. Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: Wars have been won, and friendships lost, across this board.

ingredient_words.same: All planks must be the same wood.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a wood to allow it.

recipes.name: Mason's bench
recipes.description: A split stone slab laid across two log stumps: the Stonemason's own workbench. Stonemasons make it at the crude workbench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: Every wall begins on a stone someone knocked square.
recipes.purpose: The Stonemason's own workbench. Stonemasons shape stone at it.

recipes.name: Stone stool
recipes.description: A rough stone knocked square all the way down with the maul, one corner knocked off and a crack down its back: a stool the log stool's size. Stonemasons make it at the mason's bench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: It will outlast the table, the hall and very likely the dwarf.
recipes.purpose: A seat like the log stool: dwarves rest, eat and play on it, it takes a table's guides, and it turns to a nearby fire.
recipes.purpose_short: A seat like the log stool, in stone.

ingredient_words.same: Each stool is one rough stone.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a stone to allow it.

recipes.name: Rudimentary hearth
recipes.description: A 2 × 2 hearth: an open fire against a great split boulder that throws its heat into the room. Two matching logs and four rough stones. Stonemasons make it.
recipes.flavour: A room with a hearth is a home; without one, a cellar.
recipes.purpose: Warms a small enclosed bedroom at night. Face the opening into the room; larger rooms may need more heat. A worker lights it at dusk with a log; it burns until dawn.

recipes.name: Dried fish
recipes.description: Fresh fish split and hung on the drying rack until the air has taken the water out of them: a day on the rack, then a Ranger takes them down. Dried fish keep about thirty days, longer kept cool, where fresh ones keep two or three.
recipes.flavour: Tough as a boot, and twice as welcome in midwinter.
recipes.purpose: Keeps the summer's catch for winter. Two fish of one kind hang on the rack together for a day.

ingredient_words.same: A batch is two fish of one kind.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a fish to allow it.

recipes.name: Basic smelter
recipes.description: One great rough stone knocked hollow, a stone pot in its top and a fire hole in its foot, beside a casting stone with a bar mould: the Blacksmith's own workbench, made at the crude workbench.
recipes.flavour: Every forge in the deep began as a pit of coals and a patient dwarf.
recipes.purpose: Blacksmiths melt copper ore in it and cast it into bars.

recipes.name: Anvil stone
recipes.description: One great rough stone with its top split off level and nothing else done to it: the stone a Blacksmith hammers copper on. Blacksmiths make it at the crude workbench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: A smith's first anvil is whatever the mountain would not let them break.
recipes.purpose: Blacksmiths hammer copper bars into the other trades' tools on it, also while the smelter melts the next bar. It serves until iron brings a forged anvil.
recipes.purpose_short: Where the trades' copper tools are hammered.

ingredient_words.same: Each anvil stone is three rough stones.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a stone to allow it.

recipes.name: Copper bar
recipes.description: Two copper ore thrown into the stone pot in the smelter's boulder, over a fire of coal or logs blown up through a hollow stick. The charge melts by itself for a few hours, then a Blacksmith takes the cast bar off the casting stone.
recipes.flavour: Green stone in, red metal out, and a dwarf who smells of smoke for a week.
recipes.purpose: The metal of the other trades' tools. Every batch also counts toward the level iron will need.

ingredient_words.same: A batch is two copper ore and its fuel.
ingredient_words.pick: Click an ore to allow it.

batch_words.collecting: Taking a copper bar off the casting stone
batch_words.collecting_why: The charge has melted and set in its mould; the bar lands beside the smelter.
batch_words.going_why: Walking to the smelter whose copper has set.

recipes.name: Copper pick
recipes.description: A copper bar hammered into a pick's head and bound to a log haft. Blacksmiths hammer it on the anvil stone.
recipes.flavour: Stone breaks stone. Copper breaks it faster.
recipes.purpose: Required to promote a Miner. The dwarf collects and equips this pick, and digs with it in a fifth less time than a Worker with a stone pick.

ingredient_words.same: Each is one copper bar and a log for its haft.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a bar to allow it.
ingredient_words.carrying: Carrying a bar to the anvil stone

recipes.name: Copper saw
recipes.description: A copper bar hammered thin, its edge filed into teeth, and set in a long log handle bound with cord: a saw that cuts as it is drawn back. Blacksmiths hammer it on the anvil stone.
recipes.flavour: Push, and it buckles. Pull, and it sings.
recipes.purpose: Required to promote a Carpenter. The dwarf collects and equips this saw.

ingredient_words.same: Each is one copper bar and a log for its haft.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a bar to allow it.
ingredient_words.carrying: Carrying a bar to the anvil stone

recipes.name: Copper chisel
recipes.description: A copper bar hammered to a square edge, with a hammerstone maul on a log haft to drive it. Blacksmiths hammer it on the anvil stone.
recipes.flavour: The stone decides where it breaks, unless you ask it firmly.
recipes.purpose: Required to promote a Stonemason. The dwarf collects and equips this chisel.

ingredient_words.same: Each is one copper bar and a log for its haft.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a bar to allow it.
ingredient_words.carrying: Carrying a bar to the anvil stone

recipes.name: Copper hoe
recipes.description: A copper bar hammered into a broad blade and bound to a log haft for the colony's first fields. Blacksmiths hammer it on the anvil stone.
recipes.flavour: Even a soft blade wakes the soil.
recipes.purpose: Required to promote a Farmer. The dwarf collects and equips this hoe.

ingredient_words.same: Each is one copper bar and a log for its haft.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a bar to allow it.
ingredient_words.carrying: Carrying a bar to the anvil stone

sections.name: Rudimentary
sections.hint: The first camp's goods, made by Workers at the crude workbench: light, a way down, a seat, a bed and a door, and the first two trades' tools.

sections.name: Carpenter
sections.description: Timber sawn and worked at the Carpenter's own bench: planks, storage, tables, fences and games.
sections.hint: Carpenters make these: their bench at the crude workbench first, then everything else at it. Promote a Carpenter with a copper saw, which a Blacksmith makes.

sections.name: Stonemason
sections.description: Stone shaped at the Stonemason's own bench.
sections.hint: Stonemasons make these: their bench at the crude workbench first, then everything else at it. Promote a Stonemason with a copper chisel, which a Blacksmith makes.

sections.name: Blacksmith
sections.description: Copper melted and cast at the Blacksmith's own basic smelter, and hammered into the other trades' tools on the anvil stone.
later: The Smelter and the Forge join this page with iron: iron bars, then tools, hardware, weapons and armor. Iron needs a level-2 Blacksmith.
sections.hint: Blacksmiths make these: their basic smelter and their anvil stone at the crude workbench first, then copper bars in the smelter and the trades' tools on the anvil stone. Promote a Blacksmith with a stone hammer.

sections.name: Farmer
sections.description: Farmers work the colony's fields, laid out with Zones › Farming. They have nothing to craft yet.
sections.requirements: Entry tool: copper hoe. A Farmer's work is in its fields; this page waits for what a Farmer will make.
sections.hint: A Blacksmith makes the copper hoe under Blacksmith › Tools.

sections.name: Ranger
sections.description: Food from the wild, and the Ranger's own workbench: the drying rack now, more with hunting.
later: Hunting supplies, animal goods and more workbenches, such as a rack for drying hides into leather, join this page when hunting comes.
sections.hint: Rangers make these: their drying rack at the crude workbench, then dried fish on it. Promote a Ranger with a Ranger's kit.

sections.name: Miner
sections.description: Miners specialize in excavation. A Blacksmith makes their copper pick; better picks come with better metal.
sections.requirements: Miner promotion takes a copper pick, made under Blacksmith › Tools. Iron and later metal upgrades will be made by the Blacksmith too.
sections.hint: Miner is playable; this equipment section is a preview, with no Miner crafting recipes yet.

sections.name: Brewer
sections.description: Turn farm harvests into drinks for the colony.
sections.requirements: Brewing recipes, ingredients and production controls are planned.
sections.hint: Farming and brewing production will be added in later milestones.
